carried_rule: Of E's three seeds (e-s1, e-s2, e-s3: E-s seed s then E-w seed s), the carried model is the one with the median validation gap recovered in range (seed 314 scoring ordinals 500-1499, tma2-g2 --split validation). E-w alone (ew-s1..3) is reported, never carried.
shuffled_rule: The shuffled control (e-shuffled: es-shuffled, whose decision rows' error pairs are drawn from the whole training set each epoch, then ew-shuffled, trained on another scenario's truth) is scored on validation as the seeds are. If its gap recovered minus C's (paired, clustered, 97.5%) lies wholly above zero, a G2-d pass is void (recorded as not passed).
validation_rule: E is carried to test only if every gated check's point meets its limit on validation (G2-a range and course below 1; G2-b range, course and speed below 1.1; G2-c above 0.5; G2-d above 0). Otherwise seed 319 is not generated and the record says so.
rescore: Inconclusive counts as not passed. The constitution's one re-score on a larger fresh seed is not taken: no minimum effect size is declared for G2-d, so a larger seed could only narrow an interval around an effect of no declared importance (Gate S's argument).
criterion: SRD section 5 Gate 2 row as amended (owner 2026-11-06): on every sigma = 1 deg G5 row of the seed-319 test split, scenario-clustered paired bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, 97.5%, inverted_cdf medians; a pass needs the point and the whole interval on the passing side. G2-a: E / IMM, median range and course, wholly below 1. G2-b: settled rows, E / one leg, range, course and speed, wholly below 1.1. G2-c: E's gap recovered (median range, one leg to oracle) wholly above 0.5. G2-d: E minus C in gap recovered wholly above 0, void by the shuffled rule. Every physics-layer solve at the 12-knot cap; C at parameters 60e6ee63 and code 4d2c084f, open hand-over knot_at_k.
follow_on: SRD section 5: proposed in the write-up with a recommended default, adopted if the owner has not objected by the next spec. Expected default if G2-d is not passed: C is the segmenter of record, learning is recorded as not shown on MAN2, and the next lever is realistic bearing error (deferred by SRD section 1 until Gate 2 is passed, so the owner decides).
